method.delay: ns3_rx_ns - admission_ns; original SENDAT schedules transmit at admission
method.unit: ns3 simulation ms; complete application message, including routing/AP/CSMA/WiFi queues/MAC/retries/reassembly, not pure airtime or Linux wall
method.percentiles: nearest-rank ceil(p*n), median average of two central values when even
method.censoring: Absent final full delivery is unresolved at final horizon, never automatically permanent packet loss; pending_incomplete=0 does not mean no queued/inflight/unreceived message
method.window_definition: Admission-time cohort using source reported sim begin/end translated by actual fixed offset; not source-provenance classification or exact wall teardown boundary

comparison_limits: A1 Disk empty-business Native vs B RAM full-business Native differ; CPU/synchronization/IPC/RTF confounding remains.
Only completed-message delay distribution; absent deliveries are separately enumerated.
Source RT cadence/health guarded deadlines are wall-time contracts; these ns3-sim delays cannot be directly compared to300mswall.
